title: Jesus... My Whole Future Is Behind One Result Page
topic: waiting for tomorrow's result that decides his future

bible.text: Be anxious for nothing, but in everything, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my result comes out tomorrow at ten. I told my parents I'm not nervous. 😔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: One page decides where I live and who I become.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You refreshed that site four times today knowing it wasn't updated.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: What if the number isn't enough?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The nights you studied already happened. A webpage can't undo them. I don't love you differently either way.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Sleep tonight. The page will still be there, and so will I.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the friend waiting on a result this week. 🙏
